name: Most Likely To
description: Vote for the friend who fits each prompt best, and score by reading the room. Join or leave any time.
summary: Each round shows a prompt such as 'Who is most likely to forget their own birthday?' Everyone secretly votes for another player on their phone. The TV reveals the totals and crowns the most-voted player. Players who voted with the crowd score a point, so the best room reader wins. Votes stay secret, and only the totals are ever shown. Friends can join or leave at any time (3 or more are needed to play) and the rounds never run out.
